name: ovnfs
tagline: MIT CLI by Stencil that gives each coding agent its own copy-on-write checkout of any folder, git repo or not, without copying it; review with ovnfs diff, merge back with a three-way apply, and snapshot or fork checkouts — FUSE on Linux, NFS on macOS, no root

xSignals.text: Letting an agent loose in your working folder means cleaning up half-finished edits afterward. ovnfs from @stencil_labs gives each agent an isolated copy-on-write checkout of any folder, git repo or not. You review changes with diff and merge back with three-way apply.
